Class DefaultKeyValues

java.lang.Object
io.jstach.rainbowgum.keyvalues.contributor.DefaultKeyValues
All Implemented Interfaces:
LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor
public final class DefaultKeyValues extends Object implements LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor
Key values added to every event, registered as the LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor.Source.Standard.DEFAULTS source so every other source overrides them on a key collision. Values come from the "logging.keyvalues.defaults" property and from code; a property value wins over a value set in code for the same key. For example: 
logging.keyvalues.defaults=git.commit=abc123&instance.id=i-42
or from code, which may change values at any time: 
DefaultKeyValues.of(config.serviceRegistry()).put("app_status", "READY");
Every change copies the values once into an immutable snapshot that events then share, so reading them per event costs one volatile read. They are added to events only while defaults is selected by logging.keyvalues.sources, which selects every source when absent.

    clear()
    Clears all of the current thread's state in the underlying context store, including state that is not exposed as key values such as a nested diagnostic context (NDC) stack, so a pooled thread starts its next task with no context left over.

    • keyValues

      public KeyValues keyValues()
      Description copied from interface: LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor
      Key values for an event being created on the current thread. Called once per event on the logging thread so it should be cheap. It must not throw or log and should return KeyValues.of() when there is nothing to contribute. The returned key values may be live (not a copy) as long as they are not modified while the event is being created.
      Specified by:
      keyValues in interface LogEventFactory.KeyValuesContributor
      Returns:
      key values, never null.
